artworks.title: Lovers in a Thunderstorm
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with gray wash and white heightening over black chalk on buff laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing closely together. The man has wavy shoulder-length hair and is dressed in a knee-length tunic. The woman has long, flowing hair and is wearing a full-length gown with a floral pattern around the waist. They are standing against a backdrop of dense foliage and trees. In the distance, there is a body of water with sailing ships, under a dramatic sky filled with swirling clouds and lightning.

artworks.title: Fan Design [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on green paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fan with intricate designs. The drawing includes a central figure surrounded by swirling forms. The figure sits atop a creature with a face and is flanked by two smaller, winged beings. Floral motifs, butterflies, and ladybugs are present. The composition is framed within a semi-circular fan shape, detailed in pencil on a muted paper background. The style suggests a graceful and delicate approach to the elements.

artworks.title: Fan Design [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on green paper
artworks.description: The image shows a circular scene with figures surrounded by decorative elements. In the center, there are three swirling figures enclosed within a circular boundary. Surrounding the figures are swirling lines creating movement. Below and to the sides of the central circle, there are floral and abstract motifs sketched in an arching arrangement. The sketch is on yellowed paper, and there is handwritten text visible, possibly a signature and a date reading "Kandín 1906."

artworks.title: Seated Young Woman [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's upper half of the body, from the head down to her waist. She is depicted in a seated position with arms softly positioned down along her sides. Her facial features include a slight profile with a serene and contemplative expression. She has shoulder-length hair with bangs across her forehead and is wearing a dress with short sleeves. The sketch is rendered in pencil with soft shading, and there are no visible accessories or objects in her hands. The background is simply shaded with pencil strokes, lending a subtle texture around her figure, and there is a signature and date in the lower right corner of the sketch.

artworks.title: The Nauwerk Family
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of seven individuals with full bodies visible. There is a standing man reading from a piece of paper on the left, a seated woman holding an infant next to him, and another seated man gesturing with a bottle. Three women stand behind them. The background is a plain, lightly shaded indoor setting.

artworks.title: Nude Woman
artworks.medium: graphite over black crayon on light green paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 29.5 x 21 cm (11 5/8 x 8 1/4 in.)
support: 40.6 x 31.7 cm (16 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a woman from the thighs up, drawn with minimal lines. She is in an upright, slightly angled position, with one arm raised and bent at the elbow, and the other arm stretching off to the right beyond the edge of the paper. Her facial features include defined eyebrows, simple eyes, a small nose, and a mouth that appears to be in a slight smile. She has short, wavy hair framing her face. The woman is nude. The background is plain beige paper, and there is a rectangular border around the drawing.

artworks.title: Oriental in a Fantastic Headdress
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a man with a turban featuring an intricate design. He has a prominent mustache and wears a robe with a high collar. The background is minimal, with simple shaded lines.

artworks.title: Two Men Resting near a Lake
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray and black wash
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the image with distant mountains. The terrain includes hills and a path with two figures seated nearby. On the right, a cluster of trees is depicted. The artwork is monochromatic, likely created with graphite or charcoal.

artworks.title: Travelers in a Rocky Wood
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray and black wash
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 24.2 x 33.4 cm (9 1/2 x 13 1/8 in.)
support: 29.6 x 38.7 cm (11 5/8 x 15 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a tranquil landscape from a slightly elevated perspective. Trees obscure the horizon while a figure on horseback travels in the distance. Closer, another figure sits on the ground with a dog beside them. The artwork features intricate brushstrokes, creating a detailed scene. The color palette is primarily grey and black on a light background, highlighting the texture and shadows of the landscape. Trees are depicted with fine, detailed lines, suggesting a serene setting.

artworks.title: The Assassination of King Wenzel III
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and light brown wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fallen figure lying on the ground, with a group of armed figures engaged in a confrontation in an architectural interior. The fallen figure appears lifeless, wearing robes and falling backwards. The armed figures are shown in a chaotic scene, brandishing swords and weapons. The lighting creates elongated shadows, enhancing the drama. The figures are depicted with dynamic poses, displaying action. The detailed linework and attention to light and shadow convey a moment of conflict.

artworks.title: Studies for a Boatman
artworks.medium: black and blue chalk on red-brown paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows two male figures in a classical style. The figure on the left has a beard and curly hair, with detailed facial features, holding an object in one hand and an open palm in the other. The figure on the right is less detailed, with a mustache, grasping a pole across his chest. Both figures are muscular and unclothed. The background is a plain surface with sketched hands.

artworks.title: Studies of Men in Togas [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch with multiple studies of figures. Two men are depicted in loose, flowing garments, resembling togas or robes. The central figure is turned slightly to the side, holding a book with one hand underneath and the other hand holding it open. He is looking to the left, with basic outlines of facial features. His hair is short and close to his head. Another figure is shown standing in profile to the right, wearing a robe, with detailed facial features, a strong nose, and a bald head with some hair at the back. Additional studies show older men with various facial expressions, hair, and beards. The figures are outlined against a blank background.

artworks.title: View of Trento
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gouache heightened with white on brown paper
artworks.description: The image shows a town square with an ornate fountain in the foreground. Behind the fountain are historical buildings with arched windows and intricate details, including a domed roof on one. To the right, there is a tall tower with a clock face. The horizon features rooftops of buildings and distant mountains. The artwork is detailed with a color palette of browns, grays, and golds, creating a warm and historic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Wallachian Wagoners Resting
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and ink
artworks.description: The image shows three men around an animal-drawn cart. One man is standing, another is seated or kneeling, and the third is seated in the cart holding reins. Two horses are hitched to the cart. In the background, there are trees and indistinct outlines. The sketch is done in soft pencil strokes, predominantly in shades of grey.

artworks.title: Satyrs and Nymphs
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with correction in lead white
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract figures in a landscape. The drawing features a group of abstract, loosely defined figures gathered among a rugged, natural setting with tall contours. The figures are arranged in various poses, some reclining and others standing, with flowing lines depicting movement and interaction. The use of free-flowing, curved lines gives the drawing a dynamic and somewhat chaotic appearance. Shades of light and dark create depth and movement in the composition, adding to the impression of lively activity within the scene.

artworks.title: Road through the Woods near Kresselbach
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a path winding between rocky hills and trees. In the center, there is a village visible with small buildings and a spire. The style features detailed brushstrokes creating a textured environment. The color palette is dominated by warm sepia tones. There are figures walking along the path towards the village. The sky has soft, billowing clouds.

artworks.title: Flight of Stone Steps in a Garden
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.description: The image displays a perspective view looking upwards along a stone staircase that twists slightly to the right. The horizon is not visible as the view is directed up the stairs, which leads to a platform or landing where a fence or railing is outlined. The drawing features sketchy, expressive pencil lines that suggest the texture of the stone and surrounding foliage, including the bare branches of trees rising around the stairs. The color palette is limited to shades of gray, typical of pencil sketches, with areas of shading adding depth and texture to the scene. In the distance, beyond the landing, the outline of more trees can be seen faintly against the light background.

artworks.title: A Young Couple Seated near a Massive Rock Formation
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with intricate rock formations, vegetation, two figures seated on a rock, more rocks, sparse vegetation, a gentle slope towards the lower left corner, birds in flight against a light-colored sky, and an earthy color palette of soft browns and tans.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman's head and upper shoulders in a three-quarter view. She is positioned to the side with her head slightly tilted. Her facial features include softly rounded cheeks, a straight nose, and shaded eyes looking towards the viewer's left. Her mouth is closed, and her hair is neatly styled and pulled back, with a rolled section framing her ear. The woman's clothing is minimally detailed, with no visible embellishments. The background is a plain, lightly textured paper with a few small specks.

artworks.title: View of Capri
artworks.medium: graphite and gray wash
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a townscape. The horizon features towering mountains in the distance. In the foreground, there are various buildings with flat roofs and architectural details, some obscured by foliage such as a palm tree. The structures have European architectural features like domes and stonework. The artist used fine lines and hatching for texture and depth. The drawing is rendered in grey tones for a subtle and atmospheric look.

artworks.title: Scene from Act IV from Goethe's "Gotz von Berlichingen"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a formal gathering or trial. The drawing shows an interior setting where a group of individuals, dressed in historical attire, are seated around a large rectangular table on the left side. The room has tall, narrow windows lined along one wall, and several paintings or portraits hang on the far wall. In the center, an individual is standing, facing a group of soldiers or guards on the right, who are holding long staffs or spears. The soldiers appear to be presenting or guarding the central figure. The drawing is detailed with careful attention to the expressions and attire of the seated individuals, featuring elements such as caps, robes, and ruffles that suggest a historical context. The composition of the image suggests a scene of judgment or council. The precise lines and shading create a sense of formality and tension within the depicted scene.

artworks.title: View of Salzburg
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray and brown washes, heightened with pink, over graphite on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a town surrounded by mountains. The view is from a slightly elevated angle, offering a wide perspective of the landscape. The horizon is high due to the mountains in the background. The town is positioned on a hill to the right, with buildings and what appears to be a castle complex. The mountains rise in the background, adding to the scene. Trees are detailed in the foreground, adding depth. The color scheme includes blues, grays, and browns, creating a serene atmosphere. The brushstrokes are fine, emphasizing line work.

artworks.title: Alpine Landscape
artworks.medium: watercolor and black wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with tall evergreen trees in the foreground. In the background, there are hills, mountains, and a sky with some mist or clouds. The trees are detailed with soft brushstrokes, while the mountains are portrayed with lighter strokes. The color palette includes various shades of green, muted grays and blues, and a pale sky. Near us, there are rough outlines of grazing animals and a person.

artworks.title: Studies of Hands
artworks.medium: black chalk on gray paper
